purpose: Teach: カキコ/小中学校/新米/百姓/貧乏人/里山/駿/ぎょ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「掲示板への悪いカキコをしちゃダメよ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying you shouldn't post mean things on message boards.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact delivery. Opening soft but clear. Speaking as if relaying advice naturally heard. Warm undertone, no scolding edge. Slight pause before the main point, like she's translating Dad's words with care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの小中学校時代のお話を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom — I heard Dad's stories about when he was in elementary and middle school.
lines.style: Bright, unburdened tone. Quick, eager delivery. A small note of pride that he's connecting with Dad this way. Eyes up, looking pleased with himself for having listened. Natural kid energy, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「新米のお父さんだから手探りだったわ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he was finding his way as a first-time father, you know.
lines.style: Softer, more thoughtful than before. Speaking as though understanding something she hadn't quite seen until now. Gentle exhale underneath. Not sad, but tender — processing what he shared with her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「百姓一揆」の社会の宿題したよ
lines.en: Mom — I did my history homework with Dad about peasant uprisings.
lines.style: Direct, earnest delivery. No flourish. Matter-of-fact pride in having done the work together. Slight lift at the end—he's telling her something he did, not asking permission. Genuine, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貧乏人の知恵」って表現を解説して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad explained an expression to me — something about the wisdom of the poor.
lines.style: Warm, reflective quality. Speaking slowly enough to let the idea land. Not lecturing, but noticing aloud that Dad gave him something real to think about. Voice settling into that third-hour-conversation place where real things get said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと里山の自然観察に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I went on a nature observation walk with Dad in the satoyama.
lines.style: Unforced happiness. Light, present-tense energy. Describing something that just happened, still feels alive. No need to embellish—the moment speaks for itself. Simple joy in the telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「駿くんは元気そうね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said Shun seemed like he was doing well.
lines.style: Measured, observing. Relaying information he caught—Dad noticing someone else. Not judgmental, just present. The tone of someone passing along what he heard, filing it away.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ぎょっとした」って驚いた話を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom — I heard Dad's story about a time he was really startled by something.
lines.style: Eager, leaning-in delivery. Quick rhythm, alive with interest. The delight of hearing Dad surprised or caught off-guard. Fresh curiosity. Closing warm, like she's inviting Mom into the joke of having heard something true about Dad.
